The source coverage records 27 results from the two full texts—[Polyanskiy–Wu](https://people.lids.mit.edu/yp/homepage/data/itbook-export.pdf) and [Cover–Thomas, Chapter 11](https://sgfin.github.io/files/notes/Cover_and_Thomas_ch11_info_and_stats.pdf)—with both source fetches verified.

**Checks passed:** precheck 12/12; proof contracts 12/12; rendercheck 16 files; content policy 14 items; scoped dependency check with levels 0–5 and no cycles; proof layout 40 steps with zero defects.

**Readiness:** all 14 items are recorded as escalated because the required batch 4 page `finite-alphabet-entropy-and-divergence` and batch 5 page `measure-theoretic-information-and-conditioning` are unavailable. The live run-wide readiness and batch-level checks are blocked by three duplicate item IDs in batches 21 and 22. Run-wide proof-contract coverage is blocked by an empty or invalid inventory for `rate-distortion-and-lossy-source-coding`. These blockers and the temporary-snapshot recording method are documented in the batch notes; no shared run artifact was changed.
